fact: The Goldwhisker Warrens have massive, monumental double doors that are roughly fifty feet tall.
source_quote: massive, monumental double doors leading to the Goldwhisker Warrens
subject: Goldwhisker Warrens

fact: The double doors leading to the Goldwhisker Warrens are locked.
source_quote: a pair of locked double doors
subject: Goldwhisker Warrens doors

fact: The party considered sending Glabbagool under the doors to scout, claiming he was cleaning.
source_quote: They considered sending Glabbagool underneath under the pretext that he was cleaning
subject: considered scouting via Glabbagool

fact: The party rejected sending Glabbagool under the doors because the inhabitants might mistake him for a hostile ooze and kill him.
source_quote: rejected the idea because the inhabitants might mistake him for a hostile ooze
subject: rejected Glabbagool scouting

fact: Someone in the party suggested knocking on the doors.
source_quote: Someone finally proposed the radical alternative of simply knocking
subject: knocking suggestion

fact: The suggestion to knock received the response, "Oh, well, that's a remarkable idea."
source_quote: Oh, well, that's a remarkable idea
subject: reaction to knocking suggestion

fact: Daz announced through the doors that the party intends to rid the Warrens and the grotto in the general vicinity of the slime problem and needs the Goldwhiskers' help.
source_quote: Hi, we're here to uh rid the Warrens and the grotto in the general vicinity of the slime problem. We're gonna need your help.
subject: Daz announces purpose

fact: Daz claimed that they are all getting together and have sorted it all out.
source_quote: we're all getting together and we've sorted it all out
subject: Daz claims coordination

fact: A guard was startled by the party's announcement and told them not to leave.
source_quote: A startled guard told them not to leave
subject: Goldwhisker Guard

fact: The guard scampered away to consult Chief Chipgrin.
source_quote: scampered away to consult Chief Chipgrin
subject: guard consults Chief Chipgrin

fact: Chief Chipgrin wants the party brought inside.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin wanted them brought inside
subject: Chief Chipgrin

fact: The inhabitants of the Goldwhisker Warrens are wererats.
source_quote: the wererats might mistake him for a hostile ooze
subject: Goldwhisker clan
